subject.title: fix(config): reject unsupported MCP disabled config

question: Should OpenClaw accept fail-fast validation for existing unsupported MCP `disabled` entries now that doctor can migrate both root and node-host configurations?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sound, but merging intentionally changes an ignored key into a configuration failure that requires operator recovery through doctor.

options.title: Accept fail-fast migration
options.body: Merge after exact-head gates, relying on the actionable error and `openclaw doctor --fix` to recover affected configurations.

options.title: Require softer upgrade recovery
options.body: Ask for a path that warns or repairs affected configurations before strict validation can block normal startup.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast migration
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head gates, relying on the actionable error and `openclaw doctor --fix` to recover affected configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: This person coordinated the competing fixes and is the strongest available routing signal for the remaining compatibility choice.
